name: Flame Strike

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

upcast.text: The Fire and the Radiant damage each increase by 1d6 per slot level above 5.

summary: A 10-foot-radius column of holy fire: Dex save, 5d6 Fire plus 5d6 Radiant, half on a success.
text: The column is 40 feet high. Both damage types grow with higher slots.
